investment_strategy: Quality-first AI exposure with risk-aware sizing. Given elevated volatility (VIX ~22), a recent tech drawdown (NASDAQ −13.7% in 30 days), and restrictive rates (10Y ~4.25%), concentrate on dominant AI platforms and mission-critical infrastructure benefiting from secular AI demand while controlling beta. Build a 3-name core: Microsoft as the anchor AI platform (balance-sheet strength, consistent beats), Cisco as lower-beta AI networking backbone tied to datacenter/edge upgrades, and Alphabet as a selective growth kicker with strong fundamentals and product velocity. Avoid the highest-beta, most cyclical semis in this phase. Rebalance quarterly, trim after outsized run-ups, and reassess post-earnings and policy headlines (antitrust, export controls, energy constraints).

portfolio_summary.strategy_focus: Defensive tilt to the AI cycle via a dominant software platform and essential networking, complemented by a controlled allocation to a high-growth AI leader.

analysis_summary.selection_criteria: Prioritized low-to-moderate volatility, strong earnings/revenue growth, positive analyst consensus, and supportive momentum; emphasized leadership positions in AI platforms and infrastructure; de-emphasized very high-beta cyclicals and names with negative momentum or weaker consensus.
analysis_summary.market_outlook: Near term: volatility remains elevated as investors reassess AI capex and higher-for-longer rates; policy risks (antitrust, export controls) and power constraints persist. Long term: secular AI cycle intact with cloud-to-edge adoption, CHIPS/industrial policy support, and datacenter/network upgrades. Strategy: stay quality-focused, add on weakness, and reassess exposures as regulatory and rate backdrops evolve.
